auth.label: API Token
auth.description: Sanity robot or personal token sent as a Bearer credential. Create a project token in Settings > API > Tokens: https://www.sanity.io/docs/content-lake/http-auth

extraFields.label: Project ID
extraFields.description: Sanity project identifier used to select the Content Lake API origin. Find it in your project management settings at https://www.sanity.io/manage.

actions.name: get_documents
actions.description: Retrieve the latest Sanity documents by ID while bypassing the query cache.

documentIds.description: One or more Sanity document identifiers to retrieve.

includeAllVersions.description: Whether to include drafts and release versions matching published document IDs.

inputSchema.description: Dataset and document identifiers for a direct Sanity document read.

items.description: A Sanity document with its system fields and schema-defined content.

outputSchema.description: Documents returned by the direct Sanity document endpoint.

actions.name: mutate_documents
actions.description: Execute an atomic transaction of Sanity document mutations.

items.description: A Sanity create, createOrReplace, createIfNotExists, delete, or patch mutation.

mutations.description: Ordered mutations in the atomic transaction.

returnIds.description: Whether to return identifiers of modified documents.

returnDocuments.description: Whether to return the changed documents.

autoGenerateArrayKeys.description: Whether Sanity should add unique _key values to array items.

skipCrossDatasetReferencesValidation.description: Whether to treat cross-dataset references as weak during validation.

visibility.description: When committed mutations become visible to queries.

dryRun.description: Whether to validate the transaction without committing it.

tag.description: Request tag used in Sanity Content Lake request logs.

inputSchema.description: A Sanity dataset, mutation transaction, and response options.

transactionId.description: Unique identifier of the mutation transaction.

outputSchema.description: The committed Sanity mutation transaction response.

actions.name: query_documents
actions.description: Run a GROQ query against a Sanity Content Lake dataset.

params.description: Named GROQ parameters without the leading dollar sign.

perspective.description: Query perspective, such as published, drafts, raw, or a release stack.

tag.description: Request tag used in Sanity Content Lake request logs.

resultSourceMap.description: Whether to include content source map metadata.

returnQuery.description: Whether the response should include the submitted query.

inputSchema.description: A GROQ query and optional parameters for a Sanity dataset.

result.description: The JSON value produced by the GROQ query.

ms.description: Server-side query processing time in milliseconds.

query.description: The submitted GROQ query when returned by Sanity.

syncTags.description: Synchronization tags associated with the query result.

outputSchema.description: The Sanity query response, including its JSON result.
